name: B10-0177/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks Azerbaijan to free all Armenian prisoners held in Baku jails, including eight former Nagorno-Karabakh leaders whose trial started in January 2025, and to give them fair trials. It also asks the European Union to suspend energy trade with Azerbaijan until human rights improve and political prisoners are released, and to consider sanctions on officials responsible for violations.

- The text changes no law; it is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests to Azerbaijan and the European Union.
- It concerns Armenian prisoners in Azerbaijan and the European Union's energy and human rights dealings with Azerbaijan.
- Next, the resolution is sent to the European Union's Council and Commission and to the governments of Azerbaijan and Armenia; whether anything follows depends on them.
